notes.title: Sand is settled, new patch appears
notes.notes:
Hello hello, thank you for your support and attentionNew week new patch, it won't be like this always but now emplimanting your feedback.Rebalance
Now spike parkour on Level 3 will be easier. Platforms will stay active twice more time so you can coordinate better (it was possible before btw)

Added a hint so you can better understand an ending puzzle on level 4

Added an explanation on apple usage

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/a2afdd169b612bb3b200f78b0a314467e2f3ad2f.gif"]
Bugs
FINALLY arrow now ALWAYS switch players!!!! Almost...there is still sometimes occurs problems when ping is high, around 300+ms. Or one time I caught a moment when it disappears at all, but restart helps. BUT now it happens so rarely that you should think that you're lucky if this happens to you :)

Second secret level now works
Improvements and additions
Performance improvements overall but especially for Desert location. We optimized models and light. In future planing to add a "disable shadows" option.

More decorations around Castle (first) location, so you fell more at home

Slightly changed arrow trajectory, now feels more controllable. Also it less likely to go through wall is you shoot it near it.

Now Knight boss fight includes one more element, when it hits a wall, candelabras fall from ceiling and cause a dangerous fire!!!! Boss battle is much more entertaining now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/1b4637ee65915439cb65fd707212bfc311f3a0fa.png"][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=--F-ghJipD0"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Hotfix 16.08.2025
notes.notes:
Ooopsie forgot to unlock level 2, before you just skiped to level 3 from 1. Now you can transit to it trough level 1 propeerly

Worm boss is now better

Skeletons now detect second player properly. I missed a -0.3 Y so ray casted above player...

Some minor sound improvments

notes.title: Post-demo launch update
notes.notes:
Since launch of Demo 2b1a reached 100 wishlists! Thank you ❤


This update for Demo do not change gameplay features but improves performance significantly! Both hardware and net.

+30 fps on average due to models optimization

Upgraded light and shadows

No more "Arrow not switching" bug (hopefully)

Finally nice main menu

Little tweaks to make playing better for exempel when host exits game now it close for client too
What next?
Well Desert location is done for 60% but hardest part is only to be done. Boss battle... I won't spoiler who it will be yet, but you can try and guess in comments.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/5f0818985bcdcc084173f49178a526131db1f671.png"]

After completion of 2nd level pack game will enter Early access! Maybe... So this is part where I need YOUR opinion. Lately I heard a lot of negatity about all this early access thing but I feel like main issues are can be solved very nicely with our model of updates and won't conflict with player expirience that much. So you won't lose any significant portion of game when new levels come out. What I mean by that is that there is no need to return back to first location when new comes out becouse every level pack is developet separatly. Maybe there is other problems so that is why I am asking. 
Also you'll see a new cinematic trailer hopefully soon! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690615/85550f5d5415863bb6ddb79ba841a84be03c7cde.gif"]
